title: Cherrypicking Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Our most robust cherrypicking protocol. Specify aspiration height, labware, pipette, as well as source and destination wells with this all inclusive cherrypicking protocol. Your `Transfer .csv File` should be a .csv file formatted in the following way: ``` Pipette Mount to use,Source Labware,Source Slot,Source Well,Source Aspiration Height Above Bottom (in mm),Destination Well,Volume (in ul) left,4x6 2ml screw true,1,A1,1,A11,1 left,4x6 1.5ml snap,1,A1,1,A5,3 right,8x12 0.5ml snap,2,A1,1.5,H12,7 ... ``` You can also download a template [here](https://opentrons-protocol-library-website.s3.amazonaws.com/custom-README-images/6d7eb7/ex.csv). **Please making sure to include headers in your .csv file.** Your source labware selection in the .csv file must be one of the following options, which correspond to the different sample tubes you use in your workflow: * `384 wellplate` * `96 wellplate` * `4x6 2ml screw true` * `4x6 2ml screw false` * `4x6 1.5ml snap` * `4x6 1.5ml screw` * `8x12 strip` * `8x12 1ml plug` * `8x12 0.5ml snap` The height offsets of different tubes seated in the same tuberack will be automatically calculated in the Python protocol logic. However, **please ensure to calibrate your tuberacks with the following tube types in spot A1**: * 4x6 Opentrons tuberack: 2ml screwcap false bottom in spot A1 * 8x12 ThermoScientific Matrix tuberack: 1ml plugcap in spot A1 Calibration to these tubes and tuberacks will allow for offsets to be properly taken into account during the protocol run. ---

steps.title: Aspirate specified volume
steps.instruction: Aspirate the user‑specified volume from the designated labware and well, using the slot and the aspiration height (distance from the bottom of the well) provided in the imported CSV file.

steps.title: Dispense specified volume
steps.instruction: Dispense the aspirated volume into the user‑specified destination labware and well, using the slot indicated in the imported CSV file.

steps.title: Repeat for all CSV rows
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 1 and 2 sequentially for each entry (duration) in the imported CSV file.
